entries.en: How the hell are you in Mikoshi?
Where are we? This a dream?
What is up with this? Why you actin' so weird?
entries.ro: Ce-i cu tine? De ce te porți așa ciudat?

entries.en: Arasaka do this, hit you with Soulkiller? How's that even possible – you died.
entries.ro: Arasaka ți-a făcut asta, cu Soulkiller? Cum dracu' e posibil – ai murit.

entries.en: Arasaka kill your soul, copy you?
entries.ro: Arasaka ți-a ucis sufletul, te-a copiat?

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="chica" b="Gonna be up to our necks in juicy contracts, " a=", I can feel it."/>
entries.en_m: <mothertongue l="mex" m="bróder" b="Gonna be to up our necks in juicy contracts, " a=", I can feel it."/>
entries.ro: <mothertongue l="mex" m="chica" b="O să fim până la gât în contracte bănoase, " a=", simt asta."/>
entries.ro_m: <mothertongue l="mex" m="bróder" b="O să fim până la gât în contracte bănoase, " a=", simt asta."/>

entries.en: It'll be all right, V, you'll see.
entries.ro: O să fie bine, V, o să vezi.

entries.en: <mothertongue l="mex" m="mamita" b="Hit the major leagues, " a="! Runnin' with Dex! Fat-assed Black Jesus of the Afterlife. A heap of partly gold-plated cool. Not bad, eh?"/>
